settings.title: YDM settings
settings.heading: Settings
settings.enabledHelp: Takes over large downloads from the browser. When off, the browser downloads everything as usual.
settings.minSizeHelp: The browser downloads smaller files: they finish before extra connections would help.
settings.connectionsHelp: Each connection downloads a piece of the file. YDM starts with fewer and adds more only while the speed keeps rising. Browsers allow 6 connections per site in total, shared by every download from that site.
settings.parallelHelp: The others wait in the queue and start as soon as one finishes.
settings.speedLimitHelp: To leave bandwidth for everyone else while you download. Applies to all YDM downloads together, and changes running ones right away.
settings.programsHelp: Files like .exe, .msi and .bat are downloaded by the browser, so Safe Browsing also checks the site they come from. When off, programs download fast too, but the browser sees them coming from YDM and only checks the file.
settings.checksumHelp: Computes each finished file's fingerprint, to compare with the one published by the site. Runs while the file is being saved.
settings.languageHelp: Automatic uses your browser's language, or English if YDM is not translated into it yet.
settings.notifyHelp: A system notification, with a button to show the file.
settings.sitesHelp: The browser always downloads from these sites and their subdomains.
settings.siteInvalid: That is not a site address. Type for example mega.nz or www.example.com.

about.heading: About YDM
about.lead: A download manager that lives in the browser: faster downloads, checked before they reach your Downloads folder.
about.free: Free and open source. No account, no ads, no paid plan.
about.private: Nothing is sent to YDM's authors: there is no YDM server.
about.keys: Online checks use your own free keys, sent only to the service they belong to.

alert.suspiciousLead: YDM stopped it before it reached your Downloads folder. Download it only if you trust the site and expected this file.
alert.blockedLead: This file is a known virus. YDM deleted it: nothing reached your Downloads folder.
alert.noHash: not computed yet: stopped before the end
alert.report: See the full report on VirusTotal
alert.uncheckedTitle: This file could not be checked
alert.uncheckedLead: YDM is holding it: nothing has reached your Downloads folder. Without the check, download it only if you trust the site and expected this file.

security.heading: Security

summary.unknown: The online services could not be reached; only the checks on your device ran.
summary.suspicious: Something about this download looks wrong.

local.credentials: the address hides the real site behind a name and password ({host})
local.punycode: the site name uses letters from another alphabet that can imitate a known site ({host})
local.ipHost: the site has no name, only a number ({host}), as is common for malware
local.doubleExtension: “{name}” looks like a .{looks} but is a .{is} program
local.disguised: “{name}” is named like a .{looks} but is actually a program

urlMalicious.other: {count} security services of {total} list this address as dangerous

urlSuspicious.other: {count} security services of {total} flag this address

urlhaus.malware: URLhaus lists this address as spreading malware

bazaar.known: MalwareBazaar lists this exact file as malware
bazaar.knownNamed: MalwareBazaar lists this exact file as malware ({name})

status.online: Protected: on your device and online
status.onlineHelp: Every download is checked on your device, and its address and SHA-256 against the services whose key you entered.
status.localHelp: Every download is checked on your device. Add a free key below to also recognize known viruses.
status.offHelp: YDM does not check downloads. The browser's own protection still applies.

security.localHelp: Looks for fake addresses, a program hiding behind a .pdf or .jpg name, and similar tricks. Nothing leaves your computer.
security.ask: Stop and ask when something looks suspicious
security.askHelp: A small window asks whether to download it. Known viruses are always blocked, whatever this says.
security.onlineLead: With your own free key, YDM asks these services about each download. YDM ships no key and has no server: the key stays in this browser and goes only to its service.
security.vtHelp: About 70 antivirus engines. Free for personal use: 4 checks a minute, 500 a day.
security.acHelp: Public databases of malware and the addresses that spread it. Free for non-commercial use.
security.keyInvalid: That does not look like an API key. Copy it again from the service's page.
security.keyRejected: The service did not accept this key. Check that it is complete and active.
security.consentNeeded: Firefox needs your permission to send download addresses to this service.
security.sentTitle: What is sent, and what is not
security.sent1: Sent: the download's address and the finished file's SHA-256 fingerprint.
security.sent2: Never sent: the file itself, your cookies, the page you were on.
security.sent3: Answers are remembered for a week, so the same file is not asked about twice.
